race.description: Aaron Grant Electrical Country Boosted Hcp (C1)
race.comment: DAYLITE (5) justified the favouritism at his third race start with a decisive 4.5-length victory over 1200m at this track with plenty in hand. Finds a fairly average C1 today from the good gate and can repeat the performance. WOLF ISLAND (9) has his hoof on the till and is due for a change of luck. Shouldered the 59.5kg from the wide gate with a slashing second over 1280m at the Canberra Acton in weaker company. Gets the right run here with the good weight drop and sure to be thereabouts. FAERYWOOD (10) found them too sharp over the 1010m on the heavy (8) surface with a battling seventh at Moruya. Ready for this trip and has solid winning prospects. GLENN'S LEGACY (2) form hard to fault but doesn't get the same map favours today.  Comes out of a decent contest after running third over 1400m at this track. Stays in the calculations.
